motionPlan.durationReason: Use the shot for one continuous upper sweep rather than another full orbit; endpoint velocity needs inspection

identity.expected: Preserve the identity, original expression, mouth state, clothing and accessories of the supplied character
identity.verify: 与原始身份基准对照全片，不能只比较首尾

motion.expected: A single continuous upper-left through UP to upper-right sweep, maintaining chin elevation while yaw changes; no neutral nod or lower route
motion.verify: 逐段核对实际转脸与抬低头，不能用侧倾替代缺失方向

range.expected: Use a readable horizontal face turn between the inspected upper-left and upper-right poses. Keep the chin lifted through the midpoint; do not lower it into a neutral or downward pose
range.verify: 输入检查记录具体幅度意图，成片核对全部极值

gaze.expected: Visible eyes follow one elevated target from screen upper-left through UP to upper-right, remaining elevated rather than glancing back to the camera
gaze.verify: 放大检查上下左右及中间段；未知不写通过

fixedParts.expected: Keep the torso, shoulder placement, camera, framing and scene lighting stable while allowing the neck to articulate naturally at its body connection
fixedParts.verify: 对照身体锚点与真实场景合成，检查颈部接缝

loop.expected: This is an open upper arc, not a closed orbit; endpoints must remain compatible with the reviewed main clip
loop.verify: 比较首尾两侧多帧姿态、运动方向与停顿

rest.expected: 当前采用原静态回退；未实现自然回正
rest.verify: 交付时说明切换限制，由用户验收实际体验

promptSpec.subjectDescription: the primary character in the supplied image
promptSpec.startPose: The actual upper-left gaze with raised chin in the first image
promptSpec.endPose: The actual upper-right gaze with the same lifted-chin intention in the last image
promptSpec.allowedMotion: Turn the head horizontally across the upper gaze range while retaining a lifted chin and directing the visible eyes toward the same elevated target
promptSpec.framing: Keep the complete head, hair or ears, neck and stable shoulder context inside the image throughout the turn

background.description: Keep the actual supplied backdrop and lighting stable; no change of scene
